name: The Station That Braids Trains
prompt: Split three narrow tracks into an elaborate open plait. Short turquoise, saffron and black carriages exchange partners on little swivelling track plates. Passengers watch from suspended footbridges shaped like blunt weaving shuttles.

name: Departures by the Spoonful
prompt: Build a row of giant silver spoon bowls embedded in a brick apron, each cradling a tiny engine. A counterweighted handle lifts one bowl to the level of a departure track. Steam curls along the polished concave metal.

name: The Steam Laundry Express
prompt: Stretch rows of fluttering white linen above a long maroon train. Its open boiler sends steam through jointed drying arms, and attendants load the folded washing into basketlike carriages. The platform doubles as a neighbourhood laundry.

name: Platform Minus Twelve
prompt: Cut a straight deep trench crossed by four chunky yellow lift bridges. Trains arrive below street level, their chimneys poking through individual slots in the platform. Porters lower passengers on benches slung from the bridge railings.

name: The Clockwork Picnic Line
prompt: Loop a miniature railway around a single immense checked tablecloth. Square dining compartments decouple and roll sideways into gaps in the table. Through their open roofs show passengers sharing food with picnickers who came on foot.
